result.sections: Coworkers.tsx:38-49 renders CoworkerChoices→CoworkerGrid, whose groups come from groupCoworkers() (useCoworkers.ts:79-90): one group per pack.category, ordered first-appearance then 'Built in','Your own','More'. Standard library categories (Arcade, etc.) are NOT separate from 'More motion' — same category groups both tiers; groupHeading() (useCoworkers.ts:41-43) only appends ' · More motion' to a category's heading if every pack in it is animated tier. Test tests/Coworkers.test.tsx:79-92,442-455 confirms mixed-tier categories keep the plain heading and standard packs render normally.
result.standard_library_below_more_motion: yes — same list, not separate sections; evidence CoworkerGrid.tsx:160-166 + useCoworkers.ts:79-90,41-43 + tests/Coworkers.test.tsx:79-92,453
result.preview_src: useCoworkers.ts:182-216 loadImages(): row.source==='bundled' → bundledSheetUrl(row.id) (avatars/index.ts:17-21); else preview===true → client.getAvatarThumb(id), else installed → client.getAvatarFile(id,'sheet.png') (tests/Coworkers.test.tsx:289 confirms non-bundled path).
result.pick_call: useCoworkers.ts:361-374 pick(): if row.installed → put(id)→client.setAvatar(id) i.e. PUT /avatar (currentId set from response, useCoworkers.ts:260-267); else startJob(id)→client.startAvatarInstall(id,{select:true}) POST .../install-job, then follow()/confirmSelected() poll GET /avatar until id matches (useCoworkers.ts:276-292,307-349). 'In use' badge = pack.id===currentId (CoworkerGrid.tsx:41-43,126).
result.likely_desktop_cause: bundledSheetUrl/bundledManifest (avatars/index.ts:17-26) only know ids 'beacon' and dev-only 'block' — any other source:'bundled' pack hits `continue` at useCoworkers.ts:186-192 and never falls through to the thumb/sheet fetch, so its preview is permanently blank. If these 8 packs' service row also has installed:false, pick() takes the startJob branch (useCoworkers.ts:373), but tests/fakeAvatarClient.ts:118 shows install-job is only valid for source==='library' — a bundled-source id would error/never install, so currentId never updates and Beacon stays 'in use'. Root cause both ways: the desktop asset map in avatars/index.ts was never extended for these 8 packs though the service labels them bundled.
